title: IPv6 Checker & Stats
subtitle: Check your connection. Explore your region.
insufficient: Not enough local observations to publish a reliable rate yet.
privacyShort: IP addresses and ASNs are not retained or displayed.
cached: Showing cached statistics (less than 24 hours old).
statsError: Statistics are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
networkError: Couldn't complete the check. Try again in a moment.
rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
invalidRequest: Please check your request and try again.
translationNotice: Translation may be inaccurate. Feedback is welcome.
translationPending: This language is awaiting professional translation. English is shown for now.
dateUtc: Dates and daily counts use UTC.
preview: Standalone preview · not running inside ChatGPT
rankingScope: Ranking scope: countries and territories in this APNIC snapshot
footerSummary: No IP or ASN displayed · No cookies · UTC dates
regionalMissing: Regional statistics are not available yet.
aboveGlobal: {difference} percentage points above the global rate
belowGlobal: {difference} percentage points below the global rate
sampleContext: These voluntary 17NAS samples describe participating connections, not every connection in the region.
checkHelp: Check whether this connection can reach an IPv6 service.
supportedHelp: This browser reached the dedicated IPv6-only probe. This result applies to that connection and does not establish general inbound reachability.
unverifiedHelp: This browser could not confirm reachability to the IPv6 probe. Network, sandbox or request restrictions can cause this; it does not prove IPv6 is unsupported.
regionalContext: Country-level statistics · background reference, separate from your connection test.
networkHelp: Estimated from this browser request. VPNs or proxies may change the location. IP addresses and ASNs are not displayed.
natDescription: NAT testing has not been run. This card opens a separate test page; it does not determine NAT type, CGNAT, packet loss or the cause of game disconnections.
natCaveat: Run the external test, then return with its result for interpretation.
rankingUnavailable: Global rankings are unavailable right now. Try again later.
modelPending: The card automatically checks the browser connection after loading. This server payload is a pending placeholder, not a measurement of the user network. Briefly say the measurement is running and refer to the card. Do not infer protocol results, country, city, IP, ASN, ISP, NAT or latency from host location, memory, or this tool request. After completion the user can choose Explain results in chat to share the measured country, protocols and HTTP request times. Failed probes remain unverified. IP addresses and ASNs are not retained, returned or displayed.
protocolNote: A dual-stack endpoint cannot independently confirm IPv4 availability. IP addresses and ASNs are not displayed to protect privacy. (Note: Duration includes HTTPS and server processing, not ICMP ping latency.)
networkAdvice: IPv6 connectivity is confirmed to this probe. Inbound access needs a separate test.
natAdvice: IPv6 is not confirmed. For remote access, you can also check NAT on 17NAS.
probeTimeout: IPv6 probe timed out; connectivity remains unverified.
probeHttp: IPv6 probe returned an error; connectivity remains unverified.
probeNetwork: IPv6 probe could not complete. Network, browser policy or CORS may be involved.
unsupportedHelp: This device could not establish a connection to the dedicated IPv6-only probe (no IPv6 route or connection refused); IPv6 is determined to be unavailable on this connection.
natAdviceUnsupported: This device could not establish an IPv6 connection to the probe. For remote access, you can test NAT on 17NAS.
shareHelp: Share only the measured country, observed protocols and HTTP request times with this conversation.
shareFailed: Could not send the results. Please retry.
sharePrompt: Explain this completed browser measurement using only the country, protocol observations and HTTP request times below. Do not infer IP, ASN, ISP, city, NAT type or ping latency from other context. A failed IPv6 probe remains unverified.
globalUnavailable: Global adoption rate is currently unavailable.
